conditions.text: C1 — PIS 18 क्वचिदेकदेशोऽप्यनुवर्तते: sometimes only part of an earlier word is carried on. Śekhara cites Bhāṣya at 4.1.27 and 6.1.93.

quotes.quote: स्पष्टा चेयम् <<दामहायनान्ताच्च>> [[4.1.27]] इति सूत्रे <<औतोऽम्शसोः>> [[6.1.93]] इति सूत्रे च भाष्ये पूर्वा च॥

conditions.text: C2 — At 6.1.131 Kāśikā says only "पद" of पदान्तात् (6.1.109) is carried.

missed.why: Named by the Śekhara itself as a Bhāṣya instance of PIS 18; no credit (also 6.1.93).
